summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature in the rich repository without committing or running anything. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union; rich/control.py adds the escape format (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and the Control.title classmethod with a docstring; rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title beside show_cursor, buffering the control only when is_terminal is true and returning that result; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a branch calling term.set_title with the title; CHANGELOG.md gets one Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (skipped on win32), test_control_title, and test_control_set_window_title (Windows-only, mocked wrapper). Nothing was run and Black was not run; line lengths were checked by eye and are under 88 characters.
